people.name: Jason
people.line: Paul's host in Thessalonica; relative of Paul

people.name: Lucius
people.line: Prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch.

people.name: Sopater
people.line: Companion of Paul from Berea, greeted the Roman church.

translations.web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
translations.bsb: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
translations.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
translations.asv: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
